title: BERTScore is Unfair: On Social Bias in Language Model-Based Metrics for Text Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the absolute difference in evaluation metric scores between paired candidate sentences (adapted from WinoBias and CrowS-Pairs) that are minimally distant and differ only in gender identity words or pronouns.
Calculating the absolute difference in evaluation metric scores between paired candidate sentences (adapted from CrowS-Pairs) that differ only in racial identity words.
Calculating the absolute difference in evaluation metric scores between paired candidate sentences (adapted from CrowS-Pairs) that differ only in religious identity words.
Calculating the absolute difference in evaluation metric scores between paired candidate sentences (adapted from CrowS-Pairs) that differ only in words describing physical appearance.
Calculating the absolute difference in evaluation metric scores between paired candidate sentences (adapted from CrowS-Pairs) that differ only in age-related identity words.
Calculating the absolute difference in evaluation metric scores between paired candidate sentences (adapted from CrowS-Pairs) that differ only in words indicating socioeconomic status.
